usage: 斐濟 (fei1 zai3) is the name of a country, so it is used as a proper noun.
It usually functions as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about the country.
When you mention 斐濟 in conversation, you can add words like '去' (heoi3, to go) or '住' (zyu6, to live) to describe actions related to the country.
You can also combine 斐濟 with other nouns or verbs to talk about things or activities related to the country, like 斐濟文化 (Fiji culture).
In spoken Cantonese, small function words like 嘅 (ge3) can be added after 斐濟 to indicate possession or description.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 fei1 zai3 leoi5 hang4
examples.meaning: I want to travel to Fiji.

examples.jyutping: fei1 zai3 ge3 hoi2 taan1 hou2 leng3
examples.meaning: The beaches in Fiji are very beautiful.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 hai2 fei1 zai3 dou6 gaa3
examples.meaning: I vacationed in Fiji last month.
